long: Half-Life: Uplink is a standalone single-player demo released by Valve in 1999, featuring an exclusive chapter not found in the full game in which Gordon Freeman fights through the Black Mesa facility to reach a communications relay. It showcases the original GoldSrc engine's scripted set-pieces and combat. This package runs the genuine Uplink gamedir on the WON Half-Life engine through Proton.
name: Half-Life: Uplink
short: Half-Life: Uplink (Valve 1999 free demo campaign, via WON Half-Life + Proton)
